patch_description:
This version retains the effective centered, scale-normalized smooth min/max-distance optimization, but replaces the varied early schedules with a consistently strong annealing path and adds checkpointed late-stage polishing.

The late optimizer compares the exact evaluator objective every 25 iterations. When the exact ratio declines repeatedly, it restores the best exact checkpoint, damps momentum, and reduces the step size. This prevents high-sharpness smooth gradients from drifting away from the nonsmooth active-pair optimum. Several deterministic tangent perturbation polish attempts are also used to explore nearby contact graphs while preserving reproducibility.
